name: A Task Unfinished

angles.text: As a young tauren, you face demanding trials on Red Cloud Mesa to prove your maturity and strength. Family and tribal duties test your endurance alongside the rites.
As a member of the Horde, you find Bloodhoof Village as a gathering place for travelers in Mulgore. It offers shelter and warm hearths to those crossing the plains.

faq.answer: An exhausted young tauren on Red Cloud Mesa asks you to carry furs to Innkeeper Kauth in Bloodhoof Village. They are still undertaking the Rite of Strength.
faq.q: What is the quest A Task Unfinished?

faq.answer: Innkeeper Kauth runs the inn in Bloodhoof Village, Mulgore. He offers weary travelers shelter, warm blankets, and hospitality as they cross the plains from the high mesas.
The young tauren's father asked for the furs to be delivered to Innkeeper Kauth. Kauth intends to make them into warm blankets for guests seeking shelter and rest at his inn in Bloodhoof Village.
faq.q: Why are the furs being delivered to the inn?

aliases: why can't the quester deliver the furs
why does the youth need help
faq.answer: The young tauren is undertaking the Rite of Strength on Red Cloud Mesa and is too exhausted to travel to Bloodhoof Village. They cannot make the journey without failing the sacred rite or collapsing from fatigue.
faq.q: Why couldn't the young tauren deliver the furs themselves?

aliases: what is the rite of strength
faq.answer: The Rite of Strength is a coming-of-age trial for young tauren on the mesa. It tests their stamina and resilience, and shows whether they can become protectors of their tribe.
faq.q: What is the Rite of Strength?

faq.answer: Bloodhoof Village is a main settlement in Mulgore's rolling plains, below the sheltered heights of Red Cloud Mesa. The village has an open inn, crafting supplies, and trade outposts.

sections.body: Young tauren on Red Cloud Mesa face rites that prove they are ready for the wider world. The trials demand strength, while tribal chores still need doing. One youth must finish the Rite of Strength and answer an urgent request from their father. Too tired to carry a bundle of furs down the mesa, they ask you for help.
sections.title: Trials on the Mesa

sections.body: Bloodhoof Village lies in the open plains below, where Innkeeper Kauth receives the furs. He intends to make them into warm blankets for weary wanderers. The plains tauren welcome travelers, and their support helps those facing solitary trials of strength.
sections.title: Hearth and Shelter

summary: On Red Cloud Mesa, a young tauren cannot finish a family chore alone. Their coming-of-age trials and their father's request leave them too exhausted to carry furs to Innkeeper Kauth in Bloodhoof Village.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Task Unfinished
